title: Invasion of Earth Unlikely, Say Researchers

image.attribution: Freak of Jesus / Wikimedia Commons / CC-BY-SA-3.0

main_content:
Should we fear an invasion from outer space?

Researchers have been searching and listening for life on other planets. They say we should not be concerned about alien beings any time soon.

Michael Garrett teaches at the University of Leiden. He is also the General and Scientific Director of the Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy.

Professor Garrett has been listening for radio signals from other planets, searching for signs of extraterrestrial life. He says advanced civilizations are either rare or do not exist in the areas of outer space he has examined. He adds that natural processes are most likely responsible for any radio signals that have been received on Earth.

He says that means “we can all sleep safely in our beds tonight. An alien invasion doesn’t seem at all likely.”

questions.question: Who is Michael Garrett?
options: A researcher studying extraterrestrial life at Harvard University
The General and Scientific Director of the Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy
A renowned scientist known for developing space travel technology
An author who has written several books on astronomy
questions.answer: The General and Scientific Director of the Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy

questions.question: What has Professor Garrett been doing?
options: Conducting experiments on space travel propulsion systems
Listening for radio signals from other planets to find extraterrestrial life
Writing a book on the history of astronomy
Teaching courses on the fundamentals of extraterrestrial communication
questions.answer: Listening for radio signals from other planets to find extraterrestrial life

questions.question: Is the alien invasion likely?
options: Yes, many researchers believe it is a significant possibility
No, Professor Garrett states it doesn’t seem likely at all
Yes, signals received have been traced to sophisticated alien technology
No, but it is anticipated to happen within the next decade
questions.answer: No, Professor Garrett states it doesn’t seem likely at all
